exposure: Threatened preterm birth at the limits of viability
outcome: Obstetricians' attitudes towards treatment and counseling in threatened preterm birth
Practical procedures in imminent extreme premature birth
cohort: 543 obstetricians at tertiary perinatal centers and prenatal diagnostic centers in Germany.
finding: The study found that there is variation in obstetricians' attitudes and practices regarding threatened preterm birth at the limits of viability, with the size of the perinatal center significantly influencing the practical approach.
